purpose: load BVH, glTF 2.0 (.gltf + external/data-URI buffers) and GLB motion into the shared MotionClip used by the mocap viewer and retarget_001

supported.bvh: ROOT/JOINT/End Site, any XYZ position/rotation channel order; unit auto-detected from leg length
supported.gltf_glb: glTF 2.0 only; skin joints (largest skin) or animated node subtrees; translation/rotation/scale channels; LINEAR (slerp), STEP, CUBICSPLINE; node matrix (static); ancestor transforms such as an Armature scale/rotation are applied; resampled to 60 fps
supported.units: leg length < 5 → meters (×100), < 500 → centimeters, otherwise millimeters (×0.1)
supported.joint_names: 100STYLE canonical names are kept; otherwise Mixamo (mixamorig:*), Blender (thigh.L), UE-style (foot_l) and VRM (J_Bip_L_UpperLeg) names are mapped; finger joints dropped; missing Toe_End is synthesized from ankle→toe; Unreal mannequin names (pelvis, thigh_l, calf_l, foot_l, ball_l, ball_leaf_l, neck_01); bones above Hips (root, Armature) are dropped
supported.in_place_clips: when the root does not travel (< 5 cm/s) but a foot sweeps ≥ 20 cm, travel is recovered from the planted foot sliding back relative to the pelvis

not_supported: FBX (convert to GLB in Blender first)
privacy: files chosen in the page are read in the browser only; nothing is uploaded or saved to the project

verification.cross_check: 100STYLE Neutral_FW converted to a GLB with Mixamo names, an Armature node at scale 0.01 (meters) and per-frame quaternions bakes to the same joint positions as the BVH (max difference < 0.05 cm over 90 frames)
verification.ui_check: a 240-frame generated GLB opened through the page file input in the desktop browser pane: 26 joints, unit m, names mapped, retarget IK error 0, no console errors; the temporary served copy was deleted afterwards

third_party_check.file: Quaternius Universal Animation Library [Standard] / Unreal-Godot / UAL1_Standard.glb and UAL1_Standard_RM.glb (CC0 1.0), from the user Downloads zip; not copied into the project
third_party_check.structure: 67 nodes, 1 skin with 65 joints, 43 animations, Armature root, meters
third_party_check.mapping: 24 joints after mapping (fingers and root dropped), toe ends from ball_leaf_*
third_party_check.ui: opened through the page file input in the desktop browser pane, Walk_Loop selected from the 43-entry animation menu; temporary served copy deleted

known_limits: rest pose foot pitch assumes the bind/rest pose stands with flat feet
user files are not persisted or registered in the catalog; adopted sources must be copied under art/ with records like mocap_100style_001
visual quality of the UAL clips on the rig is not yet reviewed by the user
UAL character proportions are stylized (hip ≈ 77 cm); scale follows leg length (1.880 px/cm)
